title: Leave Confirm
description: Tired of accidentally combat logging? Leave Confirm asks before you leave a server.
body:
# Leave Confirm

Tired of accidentally combat logging?

Leave Confirm adds a small confirmation popup before you leave a multiplayer server. Instead of instantly disconnecting when you click the leave button, you get one final choice: leave the server or stay connected.

## Features

- Confirmation popup before leaving multiplayer servers
- Helps prevent accidental combat logging
- Shows your player head in the confirmation UI
- Mod Menu support
- Configurable menu color picker
- English and German language support

## Client-side only

Leave Confirm is fully client-side. You can use it on vanilla servers, and the server does not need to install anything.

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric API
